title: Boston Gas Company submits for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Harbor Towers Condominum Trust.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: Boston Gas Company files responses to the Attorney General's Information and Data Requests. By: Thomas P. O'Neil, Counsel of Boston Gas Company.

The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclouse. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chair; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC 00-11)
Attorney General's data and information requests. By: John M. Grugan, Assistant Attorney General. (GC 00-11)
